title: Happy Smile Super Challenge Family Wish Show
description: A Japanese game show that doesn’t reward knowledge, but punishes ignorance! Each episode one lucky family makes a wish and tries to win their dreams.
quote: You have fulfilled our dreams, and dreams of our ancestors.
